meaning: Payload accepted but its declared encoding did not match the sniffed type
first action: Re-submit with an explicit content-type header

meaning: Upload stream closed before the declared length was reached
first action: Retry the upload; partial objects are discarded automatically

meaning: Manifest referenced a part that was never uploaded
first action: Re-upload the missing part before finalising

meaning: Payload checksum matched but the archive index was unreadable
first action: Rebuild the archive locally and re-upload

meaning: Declared size was below the minimum for a multipart upload
first action: Send it as a single-part upload instead

meaning: Job was placed on a worker that drained before it started
first action: Requeue the job; placement is not sticky

meaning: Placement window expired while the pool was scaling up
first action: Widen the window or pre-warm the pool

meaning: Job requested an affinity tag no worker advertises
first action: Correct the tag; unmatched affinity never falls back

meaning: Two placements raced and the later one won
first action: No action; the earlier result is discarded by design

meaning: Worker accepted the job then failed its readiness probe
first action: Investigate the worker before returning it to the pool

meaning: Read quorum not reached on a secondary replica
first action: Retry against the primary; secondaries lag under load

meaning: Compaction lagged far enough to reject new writes
first action: Wait for compaction; writes resume without intervention

meaning: Key existed but its value failed a checksum on read
first action: Escalate with the key; the replica needs rebuilding

meaning: Snapshot referenced a segment removed by retention
first action: Restore from an older snapshot instead

meaning: Write succeeded on the primary but no replica acknowledged
first action: Treat the write as lost and re-issue it

meaning: Bearer token carried permission tags that no longer exist
first action: Reissue the token against the current tag list

meaning: Bearer token was well formed but had already been revoked
first action: Issue a fresh token; revocation is immediate

meaning: Token carried permission tags but none matched the resource
first action: Grant the resource tag explicitly; wildcards are not expanded

meaning: Token was valid but presented over an untrusted transport
first action: Re-issue the request over TLS; the token is now burned

meaning: Token signature verified but its audience claim was wrong
first action: Request a token scoped to this service

meaning: Token was valid but its permission tags were empty after filtering
first action: Check the group mapping; filtered tags fail closed

meaning: Usage record arrived twice for the same metering window
first action: No action; duplicates are collapsed on the record id

meaning: Invoice total disagreed with the sum of its line items
first action: Refuse the invoice and re-run aggregation

meaning: Currency conversion succeeded against a deprecated rate table
first action: Refresh the table; deprecated rates expire in 30 days

meaning: Usage arrived for a tenant closed mid-period
first action: Record is held for manual review

meaning: Discount applied after tax rather than before it
first action: Re-issue the invoice; ordering is not adjustable

meaning: Metric cardinality approached but did not exceed the tenant limit
first action: Reduce labels proactively; no data has been dropped

meaning: Exporter was re-enabled before the offending label was removed
first action: Remove the label first; re-enabling alone loops

meaning: Metric was dropped because its name collided with a reserved prefix
first action: Rename the metric; reserved prefixes are not configurable

meaning: Trace was sampled in but its parent span was missing
first action: Fix the propagation header at the caller

meaning: Histogram bucket boundaries changed mid-series
first action: Start a new series; buckets cannot be migrated in place

meaning: Per-tenant limit was raised but the exporter cached the old value
first action: Restart the exporter to pick up the new limit
